# Heliox OS Source Repository

> Heliox OS is an open-source desktop AI system-control agent. This index routes language models and coding agents to the repository's authoritative product, architecture, safety, and contribution documentation.

Important interpretation notes:

- Heliox OS is a desktop application, not an operating-system kernel or a replacement for Windows, macOS, or Linux.
- Commands run through typed permissions, confirmation gates, verification, and recovery controls; documentation must not imply unrestricted autonomy.
- Neural-intent support is research infrastructure. Synthetic and recorded-EEG tests do not establish live brain control, human accuracy, medical use, or clinical efficacy.
- Local-first features can still call explicitly configured model or integration providers. Consult the privacy and security documents before making data-handling claims.

## Start Here

- [Project README](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/README.md): Product overview, installation, capability catalog, development setup, and current release information.
- [Website Agent Index](https://www.helioxos.dev/llms.txt): Machine-readable index for the public Heliox OS website.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Runtime components, request flow, agent boundaries, memory, learning, and deployment architecture.
- [Security](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Threat model, credential handling, permissions, reporting process, and supported versions.

## Runtime and Extension Contracts

- [IPC Message Formats](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/IPC_MESSAGE_FORMATS.md): Desktop-to-daemon request, event, approval, and result contracts.
- [Agent Development Guide](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/AGENT_DEVELOPMENT_GUIDE.md): Specialist-agent conventions and extension workflow.
- [Action Catalog Source](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/daemon/pilot/actions.py): Canonical typed action declarations used by the runtime.
- [Plugin Marketplace](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/tree/main/plugins): Reviewed plugin packages and marketplace catalog.

## Safety and Evidence Boundaries

- [Neural Intent](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/docs/NEURAL_INTENT.md): Synthetic-board, recorded-EEG, provenance, calibration, and live-hardware claim boundaries.
- [Security Policy](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/SECURITY.md): Supported security controls and responsible disclosure.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/VyomKulshrestha/Heliox-OS/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Required checks, review process, and contribution expectations.
